name: CoreWeave
overview: Large GPU cloud operator with growing reported revenue and active power, substantial secured and unsecured financing, and concentrated long-term customer exposure. Contract backlog and future lease commitments depend on infrastructure delivery; they are not cash or current revenue.

size.label: Large
size.basis: Provider-reported rounded equity market capitalization: $26.88B as of November 23; page headline and history row agree when checked November 24 at 11:09 UTC. Exact valuation time unavailable; data-source metadata says last updated November 20. This later observation supersedes the previously captured $26.99B November 23 intraday snapshot; no issuer restatement is implied. Not enterprise value. Independent share-basis check: SEC cover reports October 30 shares of Class A 465,847,732, Class B 90,277,992 and Class C 0. Those older shares have not been reconciled to the November 23 provider denominator; current and fully diluted share bases remain unverified. Large threshold: at least $10B.

questions: Freshness: SEC submissions and companyfacts retrieved November 24 at 11:05:28 UTC show the September 30 Form 10-Q filed November 12 as the latest periodic filing, with no newer November 23–24 filing in that snapshot. Its Q3 revenue and cash tags reconcile to the reviewed financial statements. Changing SEC indexes use observation dates above, not invented publication dates.

Issuer freshness: the November 23 UBS conference release was re-read November 24. The dynamic issuer news/event indexes did not expose a complete rendered list, so issuer-channel coverage is partial. The next earnings release date remains unconfirmed; the December 1 conference is not earnings.

Which customer contracts and sites underwrite each facility, and what delivery, cancellation, collateral, amortization, covenant and cash-sweep triggers apply? This prototype is a reviewed selection, not every credit agreement or a complete covenant model.
How much of the prospective $9B customer prepayment/deposit collection has actually arrived, and what restrictions, refund or cancellation terms attach? Do not add it to September 30 cash.
What GPU generation mix, installed GPU count, utilization and revenue-producing capacity reconcile to active power? The reviewed platform milestone and GW figures cannot establish these.

Can provider market capitalization be reconciled to a same-time share price and current Class A/Class B economic share basis, including ATM issuance and convertible dilution? A dated provider observation is available; that denominator reconciliation remains unverified.

How do lease commencement, construction and purchase commitments reconcile without overlap to contract-level future capex and financing? No complete all-in funding gap or rolling twelve-month maturity model is claimed.

Anonymous concentration labels cannot safely identify Microsoft, OpenAI, Meta or another named counterparty; lettered customer identities may change between reporting periods. No unsupported mapping is used.

The unnamed 453 MW project has only a first captured November 12 target observation here. Earlier original deadlines and actual phased handover dates require primary evidence before delay status can be assigned.
